finalText:
**Wrote the 4.2.0 entry** in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

Out of ~380 commits, one breaking change, one feature, ten real fixes — the rest was deps and refactors.

- Breaking: expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`
- Added: webhook retries with exponential backoff
- Fixed: full request body no longer logged, trace id survives retries, duplicate response header, pagination crash on missing cursor, latency histogram units, socket/pool leaks, and a few more

Worth a second look: "handle an empty allow list" and "tighten the token parser error message" — the commit titles don't say what the old behavior actually was, so I wrote the safest accurate reading. If either touches access control or leaks token data, you'll want to word those more precisely from the diff itself before publishing.
